summary.business_type: Utilities & Public Information Web Application (Disaster / Seismic Tracker)

top_findings.title: HTTP Content-Language header mismatch ('en-US' vs Turkish site)
Low static content density on initial load (153 words)
Missing llms.txt and AI agent discovery metadata
404 responses return Spring Boot Problem JSON instead of branded HTML

quick_wins: Remove the redundant <h1> tag so only one primary topic heading exists.
Fix server Content-Language header to 'tr' or 'tr-TR' in Spring Boot / Nginx.
Add /llms.txt with project overview and data source references for AI search citations.
Create a custom branded 404 error page with links back to the interactive map.
Add Author / Organization E-E-A-T signals and disclaimer in the footer.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: HTTPS enforced with Cloudflare Edge CDN and HTTP/3 support
robots.txt is valid, accessible (200 OK), and references sitemap.xml
XML Sitemap is valid and lists all 81 provincial earthquake routes
Canonical link element is properly configured

findings.title: HTTP Content-Language header mismatch ('en-US')
findings.description: Server sends 'Content-Language: en-US' while the site language is Turkish ('tr_TR'). This may cause geo-targeting confusion for international and regional crawlers.
findings.recommendation: Configure response header to 'Content-Language: tr' in Spring Boot application settings or reverse proxy.

findings.title: 404 responses return application/problem+json
findings.description: Non-existent routes return raw Spring Boot JSON error objects rather than a user-friendly HTML error page with navigation links.
findings.recommendation: Implement an HTML custom 404 error view that guides users back to the map.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: Official authority citations: Explicitly cites AFAD and Kandilli Rasathanesi
Educational FAQ covering magnitude formulas (Mw, ML, Md) and update intervals
High information accuracy regarding seismological metrics

findings.title: Low static content ratio on raw HTML payload
findings.description: The raw HTML contains only ~153 words of static text before JavaScript hydration. Search bots without headless execution may miss dynamic listings.
findings.recommendation: Server-side render the top 5 most recent significant earthquakes into static HTML.

findings.title: Missing publisher / organization biographical credentials
findings.description: Lacks an 'About / Contact / Editorial Policy' section explaining who maintains the platform and disclaimers regarding official emergency response.
findings.recommendation: Add a transparent About / Methodology modal or footer block with developer/team credentials.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: Strong title tag (69 characters) containing primary keywords
Well-crafted meta description (147 characters) with clear call-to-action
Complete Open Graph (og:*) and Twitter Card metadata with high-res image (1200x630)

findings.title: Duplicate <h1> tags on homepage
findings.description: Found two <h1> tags: 'Türkiye Deprem Haritası ve Güncel Depremler | AFAD Verileri' and 'Türkiye Deprem Haritası ve Güncel Depremler'.
findings.recommendation: Keep exactly one semantic <h1> on the page; demote the second to <h2> or a styled <span>.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: WebApplication schema with complete pricing ($0 TRY) and category
WebSite schema with rich alternateName variations
FAQPage schema with 5 validated Questions and Answers eligible for Rich Snippets
All schemas cross-referenced with @id nodes

categories.name: Performance & Core Web Vitals
what_works: Cloudflare CDN edge caching with dynamic compression (gzip)
Fast server response times (TTFB < 300ms)
Zero render-blocking unnecessary tracking scripts

findings.title: Leaflet map tile and vector bundle loading budget
findings.description: Interactive map assets must ensure LCP is not delayed during initial tile fetching.
findings.recommendation: Preload primary font/CSS and defer non-critical map layer controls.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness (GEO)
what_works: Robots.txt explicitly allows GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot, and Google-Extended
Concise, definitive FAQ text format is highly quotable by LLM synthesizers

findings.title: Missing /llms.txt file
findings.description: Site does not serve /llms.txt to guide AI agents to its structured data and live earthquake feeds.
findings.recommendation: Publish /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt describing the API and city-based pages.

categories.name: Images & Assets
what_works: Dedicated social preview card (1200x630 PNG) with explicit dimensions and alt text
Lightweight SVG vector icons for UI controls

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical & Quick Wins (Immediate)
items: Correct Content-Language header to 'tr' in Spring Boot WebConfig

phases.name: Phase 2: Content & E-E-A-T Reinforcement

Add About / Methodology / Disclaimer block in footer
Publish /llms.txt for AI search engine discoverability

items: Ensure each of the 81 provincial pages (/son-depremler/{city}) has unique city-specific intro text and fault line context
Implement BreadcrumbList schema on all provincial sub-pages
